question.wording: How did the client use the debt-financed distribution this K-1's code AC interest expense is allocated to?

options.label: In a trade or business the client materially participated in — Schedule E line 28, column (i)
In a trade or business the client did not materially participate in — Schedule E line 28, column (g), before Form 8582
In an investment activity — Form 4952, not this sheet
For personal purposes — generally not deductible

citation.wording: The manner in which you report such interest expense depends on your use of the distributed debt proceeds.
